scene.placeText: a tea-tasting room above a red-brick tea warehouse of the river port in her steam city on a golden afternoon — a long counter laid with rows of white porcelain tasting bowls, tea chests stacked to the beams, brass roasting ovens breathing clean fragrant steam below and tall-masted tea clippers at the wharf beyond the arched windows
scene.ownProp: a slim brass tea-sampling scoop heaped with tightly rolled dark oolong leaves, a curl of fragrant steam rising from it
scene.outfit: a tea-taster look fitted to her body — a cropped, open-necked linen blouse in cream and a short layered linen skirt in roasted-oolong amber, gold-thread tea-leaf vines climbing the hems, a belt of little glass vials of tea liquor graded from pale gold to deep reddish-brown, a wide-brimmed hat with a sprig of tea leaves, a brass loupe on a fine chain and laced ankle boots
scene.scene: she is the oolong tea-taster of the river port, leaning over the tasting counter and measuring tightly rolled leaves into a row of tasting bowls with both hands
